UPDATE telemetria_vulnerabilidades
SET cvss_score_final          = NULLIF(NULLIF($2, ''), 'null')::numeric,
    ssvc_exploitation_final   = NULLIF(NULLIF($3, ''), 'null'),
    kev_status_final          = $4::boolean,
    kev_fecha_agregado        = NULLIF(NULLIF($5, ''), 'null')::date,
    fecha_actualizacion_datos = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
WHERE cve_id = $1;

UPDATE telemetria_vulnerabilidades t
SET epss_score_final = COALESCE(
        (SELECT ROUND(e.epss_score, 4)
         FROM epss_serie_diaria e
         WHERE e.cve_id = t.cve_id
         ORDER BY e.fecha DESC
         LIMIT 1)
    , 0),
    irc_score_final  = ROUND(
        (0.15 * (COALESCE(t.cvss_score_final, 0) / 10.0)) +
        (0.25 * COALESCE(
            (SELECT e.epss_score
             FROM epss_serie_diaria e
             WHERE e.cve_id = t.cve_id
             ORDER BY e.fecha DESC
             LIMIT 1)
        , 0)) +
        (0.30 * CASE WHEN t.kev_status_final THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) +
        (0.20 * cn.peso_normalizacion) +
        (0.10 * CASE WHEN a.exposicion_internet THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)
    , 4)
FROM activos a
     JOIN criticidad_niveles cn ON a.criticidad_id = cn.id
WHERE t.activo_id = a.id;
